summary: STAAR Hub iteration 2 (Voice Guardian + Morning scenario + Judge walkthrough) PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases green in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_new.py — POST /api/demo/scenario 'morning' seeds wellbeing.slept_poorly=true, sleep_hours=4.5; GET /api/guardian/signals returns a poor_recovery signal (source=wellbeing, targets include work+style) ordered first; POST /api/guardian/coordinate-morning returns exactly 4 actions (wellbeing, work, style, home) and mutates wellbeing.gentle_start_active=true, style.planned_outfit.name='Low-effort confidence', home.lights='sunrise'; POST /api/guardian/speak returns {url:/api/tts/<32-char-key>.mp3}, first call generated audio in ~2.4s and cached call returned in <1s, GET of the url returns audio/mpeg content > 5KB, invalid coordination_id → 404, invalid tts key → 404; coordinate-evening still returns 6 actions and persists spoken_summary; /api/guardian/view returns both morning and evening coordinations. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport) verified: on fresh localStorage the walkthrough overlay renders with 5 steps, NEXT button reads 'START THE DEMO' on step 5, walkthrough dismisses and does NOT reappear on hub revisit; SKIP also dismisses. Settings → 'ACT II — MORNING · ROUGH NIGHT' returns to hub; banner shows 'You slept 4.5 hours. Recovery is low ahead of your 9:30 AM presentation.' Wellbeing portal shows morning-intervention card → COORDINATE MY MORNING opens sheet with 4 action cards (wellbeing/work/style/home) + HEAR THE GUARDIAN button. Voice button transitioned to 'SPEAKING — TAP TO STOP' (cached path <1s; on cold path allow up to 20s) and back to idle on second tap. gentle-start-card visible after closing the sheet. Style portal shows 'Low-effort confidence' outfit. Regression: scenario-evening-btn restores work overload, Work portal → COORDINATE MY EVENING sheet has 6 action cards, hear-guardian-btn present on evening sheet, OPEN GUARDIAN VIEW shows BOTH morning and evening coordinations. Settings → REPLAY JUDGE WALKTHROUGH clears the AsyncStorage flag and returns to hub — walkthrough overlay reappears.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on first load: 'CanvasKit load failed TypeError: Failed to fetch' followed by 'wasm streaming compile failed... falling back to ArrayBuffer instantiation'. The fallback works and Skia intro/hub render correctly, but the CDN fetch path is unreliable on the preview host. Consider self-hosting canvaskit.wasm (see /app/frontend/index.js) or adding retry+timeout. Reference: /app/frontend/index.js

Repeated console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' (many callsites e.g. hub.tsx primaryBtn line ~283, coordination-sheet.tsx cta line ~150) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (hub.tsx line ~139). Non-blocking but should be migrated before production.

action_items: Optional: self-host canvaskit.wasm or add retry logic in /app/frontend/index.js — the transient CanvasKit fetch failure is intermittent and always falls back cleanly, but is noisy in the console.

Optional: migrate `shadow*` StyleSheet props → `boxShadow` and `pointerEvents` prop → `style.pointerEvents` across hub.tsx / coordination-sheet.tsx / other screens to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: add EXPO_BACKEND_URL alias in /app/frontend/.env for consistency (currently only EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is set — tests fall back to either).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~880 lines and adds two more feature domains (TTS + morning coordination). Splitting into routers (auth.py, portals.py, guardian.py, tts.py, chat.py) is becoming increasingly worthwhile.

voice.ts uses a single module-level `createAudioPlayer()` instance — good for reuse but note that in dev-fast-refresh on web the previous player instance is reused across reloads; consider guarding against stale players if adding more audio surfaces.

coordination-sheet.tsx: playbackStatusUpdate `sub2.remove()` is only called on `didJustFinish`. If the user closes the modal mid-playback the listener still exists on the shared player until next replace(). Not a leak in practice but worth cleaning up in an effect return.
Pydantic v2 deprecation persists: update_profile / update_privacy still call `.dict()` instead of `.model_dump()` (server.py lines 270, 281).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_new.py (created — 10 new tests for morning scenario, coordinate-morning, TTS speak/cache/404, evening regression, guardian-view merge)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all new flows exercised (walkthrough 5-step + skip + replay, morning scenario seed + banner, coordinate-morning 4 actions, voice idle↔SPEAKING↔idle, gentle-start-card, Style Low-effort confidence, evening 6 actions, guardian-view morning+evening merge)

seed_data_creation: No manual seed needed. POST /api/auth/demo seeds the evening overload state; POST /api/demo/scenario {scenario:'morning'} seeds the rough-night state; both switch back and forth cleanly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://cross-life-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api. To test walkthrough as a fresh user, run `await page.evaluate("() => localStorage.clear()")` between navigations (AsyncStorage on web maps to localStorage, key 'staar_tour_done'). New testIDs added this iteration: walkthrough-overlay, walkthrough-next, walkthrough-skip, scenario-morning-btn, scenario-evening-btn, replay-walkthrough-btn, coordinate-morning-btn, coordinate-evening-btn, hear-guardian-btn, gentle-start-card, action-<portal> for each card in the coordination sheet. TTS: first-call latency is 2–15s depending on OpenAI response; subsequent calls hit db.tts_cache and return in <1s. Voice button on Web: `expo-audio` shared player is reused across morning/evening sheets — closing the modal calls stopVoice() which pauses the shared player. When testing voice state transitions, poll the button's innerText (idle='HEAR THE GUARDIAN', loading='PREPARING VOICE…', playing='SPEAKING — TAP TO STOP').
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found. Two non-blocking web-preview warnings persist from iteration 1: (1) CanvasKit CDN fetch occasionally fails and falls back to ArrayBuffer instantiation (Skia intro still renders); (2) RN-Web deprecation warnings for shadow*/pointerEvents. Neither affects the demo experience.
